title: Ninenin çekmecesi

characters.GRANNY: a small old grandmother with white hair in a bun, wearing a floral headscarf and a plum colored cardigan
characters.WOMAN: a woman of about thirty with curly brown hair, wearing a mustard yellow coat

scenes.text:
Ninen neden poşetleri, kavanozları,
kurdeleleri bile atmadan saklar?
scenes.prompt: An old cozy kitchen with wooden shelves full of glass jars, folded cloths and ribbons, afternoon sun through lace curtains, an autumn tree outside. No people.

scenes.text:
"Bir gün lazım olur" der,
sen de gülersin.
scenes.prompt: {GRANNY} stands at an open kitchen cupboard arranging glass jars on a shelf, smiling to herself, warm afternoon light.

scenes.text: Bir gün eski bir çekmecesini açarsın.
scenes.prompt: In a sunlit old bedroom, {WOMAN} kneels in front of a wooden dresser and pulls open a drawer, curious expression, autumn leaves outside the window.

scenes.text:
İçinde, çocukken çizdiğin
buruşuk bir resim.
scenes.prompt: Inside an open wooden drawer, a wrinkled child's crayon drawing of a little house and a smiling sun lies among folded ribbons, warm golden light.

scenes.text:
Ninen her şeyi değil, seni saklıyormuş.
Bunu ninesini seven birine gönder.
scenes.prompt: At sunset in an autumn garden, {GRANNY} sits on a bench under a tree, and {WOMAN} sits beside her on the right, both smiling, golden leaves falling.

caption:
Ninen neler saklıyor?

O çekmecede bir çocukluk duruyor. 🤍

Bunu ninesini seven birine gönder.
